journeys.acceptance: Correct package opens primary navigation on a clean profile.
journeys.runtime_check: Install the signed package on a clean OS profile; app test binaries do not validate the installer or store channel.

journeys.acceptance: No reader, empty reader, permission and loaded identity remain distinct.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise actual USB/PCSC insertion and permission grants on dedicated devices; fixtures only prove presentation.

journeys.acceptance: Selection remains stable during read, resize and removal; reread refreshes only matching card.
journeys.runtime_check: Execute the listed suites on every applicable target; inspect the native interaction and output artifacts.

journeys.acceptance: Imported names and formats are visible; removing a queued input leaves its source untouched.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise system picker, share import and desktop/tablet drag-drop; fixture-seeded queues do not prove these OS paths.

journeys.acceptance: PDF defaults to PAdES-T and other files to detached XAdES-T; explicit format is honored.
journeys.runtime_check: Select each offered format in the native menu and confirm output extension/content after simulated signing.

journeys.acceptance: Saved placement/page selection is used by signing and cancellation preserves prior settings.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise each native stamp editor, keyboard and pointer resizing; crypto placement tests do not prove editor interaction.

journeys.acceptance: One batch authorization uses the frozen certificate; outputs correspond to accepted inputs.
journeys.runtime_check: Full real-card/OS credential success remains an explicit device check; use simulated cards for automatic failure tests.

journeys.acceptance: Output names and bytes survive closing result presentation; export does not overwrite source.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise actual share/save/reveal destination; fixture output creation alone does not establish delivery.

journeys.acceptance: Recoverable input/output failures preserve successes; card/security failures stop without retry.

journeys.acceptance: Valid, invalid, untrusted, unsigned and multiple-signature states remain distinguishable.

journeys.acceptance: Details reread selected saved file without appending duplicate history.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise details/open/share/reveal on each native document list; library tests establish persistence policy only.

journeys.acceptance: Clearing history preserves saved document entries and output files across relaunch.

journeys.acceptance: Only admitted origins reach consent; deny/cancel/timeout never signs; stopped hosts ignore late answers.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise a local controlled browser page and native foreground/background transitions; live government portal is a separate opt-in integration check.

journeys.acceptance: Valid edited URLs persist, invalid schemes are rejected, selected browser data clears.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise native bookmark forms, actual navigation and data removal in WebKit/WebView.

journeys.acceptance: Saved credentials stay certificate-bound; cancellation stops signing; deletion removes only intended entry.
journeys.runtime_check: Use OS keychain/keyring authentication and an explicitly supplied session credential; no actual card PIN belongs in the test catalog.

journeys.acceptance: Language/theme changes persist and native text/layout remains readable.
journeys.runtime_check: Run presentation cases in all three locales and both themes on phone/tablet and desktop; default new journey assertions use English.

journeys.acceptance: Demo is explicit and isolated from live documents, credentials, readers and listeners.
journeys.runtime_check: Open actual Help/About/update controls; distribution-channel updates need installed package validation.

journeys.acceptance: Recovery distinguishes environmental failures and never automatically retries a rejected PIN.

journeys.acceptance: Close/reopen/menu Quit follows the documented background lifetime.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise menu bar and window actions in the signed desktop app.

journeys.acceptance: Launch preferences and insertion deduplication are honored.
journeys.runtime_check: Validate macOS Login Items approval and helper launch using installed standalone artifact; Store controls differ.

journeys.acceptance: Browser enable/stamps/legacy toggles enforce capabilities and recover from port conflicts.
journeys.runtime_check: Toggle native preferences and inspect loopback listener ownership; test standalone and Store capability differences.

journeys.acceptance: Private spool request requires explicit approval and output retrieval; cancelled request never signs.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise signed helper plus native approval broker; use simulated signing for automatic protocol cases.

journeys.acceptance: Import through system Files/share extension and export through system share UI.
journeys.runtime_check: Run on both dedicated iPhone and iPad; app sandbox copies do not prove provider interaction.

journeys.acceptance: Wide and compact layouts retain selection and queue through rotation/resize.
journeys.runtime_check: Run the same cases on explicit phone/tablet/Duo devices and perform genuine split-view drag/drop.

journeys.acceptance: Prepare opens foreground approval; Verify returns offline result; input limit enforced.
journeys.runtime_check: Invoke the installed App Intents through Shortcuts; policy tests do not execute Siri or system routing.

journeys.acceptance: Only readable app-owned signed metadata appears and deleted/disabled entries disappear.
journeys.runtime_check: Search/open through actual Spotlight on an installed signed app; verify returned document and foreground navigation.

journeys.acceptance: Handoff resumes Documents only, without transferring data or authorization.
journeys.runtime_check: Requires two eligible signed-in devices; verify no document/PIN/certificate state transfer.

journeys.acceptance: USB grants and external-browser notification route to a single consent prompt.

journeys.acceptance: Rail/compact layout retains queue/card when resized.

journeys.acceptance: Installed package starts in the desktop session with PCSC/CCID configured.

journeys.acceptance: Startup/background preferences persist and system browser remains external.

journeys.runtime_check: Exercise native preference import and TLS handshake with test identity, including Flatpak storage.

journeys.acceptance: Locked/unavailable vault differs from incorrect card PIN and cancelled lookup cannot show a late prompt.

journeys.acceptance: Native Documents action encrypts into a separate output and persists its library entry.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise native picker/password/save flow on all platforms; crypto/storage tests alone do not prove the UI.

journeys.acceptance: Correct password restores identical bytes; malformed or rejected envelopes create no plaintext output. Legacy CBC cannot authenticate the password or content; accidental valid padding is not proof of correctness.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise native decrypt selection and destination step, then compare original/restored bytes without recording passwords.

journeys.acceptance: Only the selected app-owned file is removed after confirmation; other outputs and history stay consistent.
journeys.runtime_check: Exercise native confirmation and filesystem readback in a disposable document library. Mobile removal is not applicable.

assertions: Press the native Sign action
Both sample inputs complete and leave the queue
No PIN entry is requested
First sample fails with a document error
Second sample completes
Failed input remains visible without automatic retry
Mock credential failure stops the batch
No outputs are produced
Both inputs remain queued
Choose XML through native file or batch options
Confirm the chosen format
Remove queued inputs without producing outputs
Open the actual stamp editor over a sample PDF
Cancel and return to the intact queue
Cancel history clearing and retain entries
Confirm history clearing
Saved output library remains accessible
Expand certificate and technical sections
Collapse them again
Verification uses fictional reports without card access
Dismiss a native consent or PIN prompt without entering credentials
Prompt closes and no signing starts
